description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the BLEU score and the average lagging (AL) for different consistency measures in simultaneous machine translation. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)," is a linear scale ranging from 1 to 8. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU," is also a linear scale ranging from 20 to 30. The plot includes four lines, each representing a different consistency measure. The "Consistency-CE" line is represented by a purple dotted line with circle markers, the "Inconsistency-CE" line is a purple dashed line with square markers, the "Inconsistency-CE-MP" line is a blue dashed line with square markers, and the "Consistency-Bi" line is a red solid line with star markers. The "Consistency-CE" line starts at a BLEU score of approximately 22 and ends at around 30, showing a steady increase. The "Inconsistency-CE" line starts at a BLEU score of approximately 20 and ends at around 28, also showing a steady increase. The "Inconsistency-CE-MP" line starts at a BLEU score of approximately 22 and ends at around 30, showing a steady increase. The "Consistency-Bi" line starts at a BLEU score of approximately 24 and ends at around 30, showing a steady increase.
